anomalies.message: AI system is not generating any opportunities or making adjustments, indicating potential malfunction or misconfiguration.
CPU load average is high across all intervals, which could indicate potential performance bottlenecks.
Trading system has a win rate and ROI of 0, suggesting no profitable trades have been made recently.

Consider load balancing or optimizing processes to reduce CPU load and improve overall system performance.
Review and potentially adjust trading strategies to improve win rate and ROI.
